import requests
url = "https://view.eumetsat.int/geoserver/wms?service=WMS&version=1.3.0&request=GetCapabilities"
r = requests.get(url, timeout=20)
text = r.text
import re
for layer in ["msg_fes:clm", "msg_fes:cth"]:
    idx = text.find(f"<Name>{layer}</Name>")
    if idx == -1:
        print(layer, "NOT FOUND in capabilities")
        continue
    chunk = text[idx:idx+2000]
    m = re.search(r"<Dimension[^>]*name=\"time\"[^>]*>(.*?)</Dimension>", chunk, re.S)
    if m:
        print(layer, "TIME_DIM:", m.group(1)[:300])
    else:
        print(layer, "no time dimension found nearby, snippet:", chunk[:400])
PYEND
